reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Support for Consul, deprecated since v1.12, has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: workload-failure

consequence.statement: Cilium deployments configured to use Consul for state synchronization will fail to function, as Consul support has been removed and is no longer available in this release.
consequence.remediation: Remove Consul configuration from Cilium settings before upgrading, or keep Cilium on v1.16 or earlier. Migrate state synchronization to supported backends.

proposed.statement: Support for Consul state synchronization, deprecated since v1.12, is removed and no longer available.
